sampling.title: SAMPLING
sampling.uploadTooltip: Upload the quality report (Excel, PDF or photo), then use Extract data to read the per-palka FFA and Moisture values. You review them before they are filled in.
sampling.extractTitle: Read palka FFA and Moisture values from this document
sampling.entriesHint: Enter per-palka FFA and Moisture values, then add to the list.
sampling.qualitySummaryTooltip: The figures printed in the report's own summary box. These stay as stated even when a palka row is missing, so they can differ from the averages computed below.
sampling.qualitySummaryReadonly: FFA Average: {{ffa}} · Moisture Average: {{moisture}} · DOBI: {{dobi}} · Iodine Value: {{iodine}}
sampling.addTitle: Press Enter in field, then Add
sampling.noRecordsYet: No sampling records yet. Add one above.
sampling.extractError: Could not extract data from this document.

extractReview.title: Review extracted sampling data
extractReview.nothingUntilApply: Nothing is changed until you press Apply.
extractReview.emptyExtract: No palka FFA / Moisture values could be read from this file. Enter them manually, or try uploading the original Excel file or a clearer scan.
extractReview.startTimeOption: Set Start Time to the document date ({{value}})
extractReview.applyDisabledTitle: Select at least one row or option

extractWarning.ocr_quality: These values were read from an image. Rows the reader could not identify are left out rather than guessed, so check that every palka in the document is listed below before you apply.
extractWarning.vessel_mismatch: Document is for "{{documentVessel}}" but this operation is "{{operationVessel}}". Check you uploaded the right report.
extractWarning.palka_count: Found {{found}} palka rows but this vessel is recorded as having {{expected}}.
extractWarning.avg_ffa_mismatch: Report states an FFA average of {{stated}} but the rows read average {{computed}}. Some rows may be missing or misread.
extractWarning.avg_moisture_mismatch: Report states a Moisture average of {{stated}} but the rows read average {{computed}}. Some rows may be missing or misread.
